native_states.unfound: Render.Visible=false, small crack name, y foreground/layer1 defaults; do not draw or reveal it from art.
native_states.found: HiddenRender.Reveal sets Visible=true, stone crack name, same sw_crack tile, foregroundY/layer3; searched Intelligence+Bonus difficulty2 or Radar/LitRadar can reveal.
native_states.liquid: RenderLiquidBackground delegates to existing open liquid primary/secondary background; preserve current background and source detail, do not bake water or animate a new spray.

palette: Primary source foreground y before reveal and Y after reveal; exact native detail/background stays source/event owned. No fixed red stone color despite description.
source_shape: Inspect actual sparse primary/detail crack strokes before construction; visible revealed state is not an invisible-widget exclusion.

donor_reference.role: Actual RimWorld rough stone surface/edge contrast only; no filled rock tile, new boulder, different stairs or changed world geometry.

frame.rule: One fixed ground-plane frame, no independent alpha fitting or extra facing/rotation.

native_behavior: Keep HiddenRender discovery, search/radar, native navigation weighting, Connect direction d/type StairsUp and StairsDown interaction, MentalShield/NoDamage and RenderLiquidBackground. No new transition, reveal trigger, liquid state or world geometry.
native_acceptance: Pending all generation; require hidden/revealed/liquid-background checks in final whole-set test.
